info.title: Ablaki World API — implemented foundation
info.description: Implemented world foundation. Storage routes are defined in world-storage.openapi.json. No migrations or runtime checks have been performed. Commands require a server quote and exact replay of request_key, payload, quote_id and expected_revisions. Feature flags default off. Workspace and recovery routes are defined in world-workspace.openapi.json; equipment instance revisions are supported.
